# `data/workstation/` — assets for `Rebot-Workstation-PickPlace1-v0`

Three kinds of thing live here, and they are produced three different ways.

## Authored, and regenerated by a script in this repo

| file | written by |
|---|---|
| `box.usda` | `scripts/author_workstation_box_usd.py` |
| `objects/cube.usda`, `objects/cube_p00…p07.usda` | `scripts/author_rubiks_cube_usd.py` |

Both import their dimensions from `re3sim/mdp/common.py`, so the geometry and the "placed"
predicate cannot silently disagree. Regenerate with:

```
python scripts/author_workstation_box_usd.py
python scripts/author_rubiks_cube_usd.py --variants 8
```

`cube.usda` is the default pattern; `cube_p00` is the **solved** cube (the one a human can
check by eye) and `cube_p01…p07` are distinct valid scrambles. `RE3SIM_CUBE_PATTERN=<n>`
selects one at load time. By default the env goes further and gives **every env its own
pattern** — see `mdp.randomize_cube_pattern`.

## Reconstructed, and NOT required

`objects/rolloftape.usda` and `objects/tapemeasure.usda` are photogrammetry assets from the
Re3Sim pipeline. The env uses **analytic primitives** for the clutter by default; these are
only loaded under `RE3SIM_SCANNED_CLUTTER=1`, for an A/B. `objects/*_report.json` are their
build reports.

## The gaussian desk — NOT in this repo

`splats.usd` is expected to be a symlink to the NuRec field built by the Re3Sim workstation
pipeline (`Re3Sim/workstation/tools/finish_scene_splats.sh`). It is deliberately
`.gitignore`d: it is a 356 k-gaussian build artefact of a different repository, and what sits
here on the build machine is an *absolute* symlink that would dangle for anyone else.

Without it the env falls back to a placeholder desk and says so at load time:

```
[workstation] desk: PLACEHOLDER SeattleLabTable -- splats not built yet
```

To point at one:

```
ln -s /path/to/Re3Sim/data/scene2/splats.usd        source/reBot_RL/data/workstation/splats.usd
ln -s /path/to/Re3Sim/data/scene2/splats_splats.usd source/reBot_RL/data/workstation/splats_splats.usd
```

`RE3SIM_SPLATS=/some/other/field.usd` overrides the path without touching the symlink, which
is how a re-trained or pruned field gets A/B-rendered against the shipped one.
